categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the pharmaceutical and medical device sectors, focusing on the production and sales of anti-liver fibrosis drugs (notably the patented compound Soft Liver Tablets) and liver fibrosis diagnostic equipment (FibroScan series). It also provides medical services including managed healthcare strategies for liver disease and pediatric health management. The business model integrates pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and healthcare services to offer comprehensive liver disease management solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes patented compound formulations for its pharmaceutical products, with Soft Liver Tablets being the first anti-liver fibrosis drug approved by China's National Medical Products Administration. Its diagnostic devices employ advanced transient elastography technology (VCTE™) for non-invasive liver stiffness measurement, supported by proprietary software for data management. The FibroScan devices have multiple international certifications (CE, FDA, NMPA) and incorporate patented technologies like LSM, SSM, and CAP for liver and spleen stiffness and fat quantification.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include hospitals, healthcare institutions, and pharmaceutical distributors domestically and internationally. The company serves liver disease patients, particularly those with chronic hepatitis, liver fibrosis, and fatty liver disease, as well as pediatric patients through its healthcare management services. Major markets include China and over 100 countries globally, with significant presence in Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Inner Mongolia and offices in Beijing. It has a global footprint through subsidiaries and affiliates in France (Echosens S.A.S.), Luxembourg, the United States, Germany, Spain, Italy, the UK, and Singapore. Its products are sold and used in more than 100 countries worldwide, supported by a global sales network and production bases.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, engaging in research and development, manufacturing, and direct sales of pharmaceutical products and medical devices. It also provides healthcare services, including managed medical care and digital health management, positioning itself as an integrated provider from product development to end-user services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding global market penetration of FibroScan devices, enhancing liver disease patient management through digital health platforms, and advancing the management-style medical service model. R&D focuses on upgrading FibroScan technology, developing diversified and intelligent liver disease diagnostic products, and supporting clinical research collaborations with global pharmaceutical companies. The company also invests in a large-scale health technology park and liver disease data center to consolidate its leadership in liver health.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of pharmaceuticals and medical devices, including direct sales, leasing, and per-use charges for diagnostic equipment. The company also earns income from medical services and digital health management. Additionally, it receives investment income and government subsidies, with a growing emphasis on integrated product-plus-service offerings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the liver fibrosis diagnosis and treatment market, with its FibroScan device recognized globally and recommended by major health organizations such as WHO, EASL, and AASLD. It competes with other medical device manufacturers and pharmaceutical companies in the hepatology field. Its patented drug and innovative diagnostic technologies differentiate it from competitors, supported by strong academic endorsements and clinical guideline inclusion.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.35 billion, representing a 16.93% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 113.3 million, up 11.54%. The company’s assets totaled over RMB 3 billion with steady growth in both domestic and international markets. R&D investment accounted for nearly 11% of revenue, reflecting a strong growth and innovation trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its unique patented anti-liver fibrosis drug as the first nationally approved treatment in China, combined with globally pioneering non-invasive liver diagnostic technology (FibroScan). Its integrated 'drug + device + service' model offers comprehensive liver disease management, enhancing patient compliance and clinical outcomes. The FibroScan device’s clinical validation, international certifications, and inclusion in over 200 authoritative guidelines provide strong differentiation and credibility in the global hepatology market.
